register.text: The illustrative application approves a name and address. Successful Insert folding creates the unique representative in its application output. Approval does not reserve ordering.

resolve.text: Authenticate the registry, representative and current application output before reading its address. Pending requests and retired or absent keys provide no current application address.

change-address.text: The application authorizes moving the same representative to a new datum. There is no registry Update, mint or burn.
